line1.speaker: Scratched into the rock
line1.text: Ink holds where the stone remembers it. Out in the open it forgets, and [shake]crumbles[/shake].

line2.speaker: Scratched into the rock
line2.text: Red ink is ink that never took. Start your line at something solid.

line3.speaker: Scratched into the rock
line3.text: The wall ahead does not care how high you can jump. Draw yourself a slope.
